tool.name: OpenClaw
tool.description: Personal AI assistant platform — run your own AI on any device, any channel

releases.name: openclaw 2026.10.5
releases.body:
## 2026.10.5

### Highlights

- **Updates finish and recover on their own:** `openclaw update` completes across devices, filesystems, pnpm 12, Windows elevation, and macOS login shells, settles stale handoff leases and package-activation journals instead of stranding the install, keeps busy or unhealthy Gateways from blocking the update, and `--no-restart` package updates now report success honestly. (#164769, #165863, #166695, #167302, #169410, #170046, #172196, #172640, #173358, #173409, #174649, #171015) Thanks @shanselman, @patrickschiller, @RomneyDa, @SergeiAug, @giulianoaccorsi, @mwbroxson, and @Bamorem.
- **Restart-safe conversations:** interrupted turns, first messages during worktree preparation, subagent work, and deferred tasks resume after a Gateway restart, and user input and committed session data survive restarts, concurrent writes, and failed publications. (#165333, #166042, #165184, #168650, #169144, #170161, #170223, #165502, #167570, #166010, #167662) Thanks @DonnieFi, @jjjhenriksen, and @RomneyDa.
- **Faster, lighter Gateway:** session, transcript, history, and metadata reads move onto worker threads with far less SQLite work per turn, startup maintenance runs after readiness, and Gateway startup and memory search workers use less memory, back in the 2026.10.4 range. (#164744, #165470, #165614, #166587, #167194, #164779, #165028, #166041, #167278, #165993, #174718, #172392) Thanks @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, and @jjjhenriksen.
- **Reliable turns and subagents:** turns recover from stalled streams, reused tool-call IDs, expired ChatGPT websockets, and malformed OpenAI or Google streams, incomplete turns end with a visible notice, and subagent results keep returning through restarts. (#165983, #167013, #165212, #167972, #166846, #168400, #173404, #173612) Thanks @cestercian, @Irish-Joseph, @rmyers64, @sszyh2026, and @RomneyDa.
- **X channel:** answer X (Twitter) mentions through a new channel plugin with streaming, guest mode for repository questions, and enforced API cost limits. (#165138, #165337, #165354, #165351)
- **Voice calls:** voice calls gain per-call briefs, call reports, live steering, callbacks, and voicemail detection. (#165716) Thanks @mbelinky and @jacobtomlinson.
- **Smarter model pickers and new models:** pickers lead with each provider's recommended models, show newly listed Claude, ChatGPT, and Ollama models without waiting for an OpenClaw release, and Google adds Gemini 4 Argon and Gemini 3.8 Flash. (#167370, #166737, #167658, #167387, #167463, #171852, #172339) Thanks @obviyus.
- **ClawHub in the Gateway:** browse and search ClawHub plugins and skills from the Gateway, and plugins automatically pick the newest official release your OpenClaw supports. (#163459, #167485, #166588) Thanks @jacobtomlinson and @charlesBerg-ux.

### Changes

- **Tool approval hooks:** ordinary hooks can no longer rewrite trusted-inline-approved tool arguments without another approval, and transforming plugins must request separate approval for their final arguments or the call is blocked; see `docs/plugins/hooks/tool-policy.md` for migration. (#142700) Thanks @giodl73-repo and @giodl73.
- **Sessions:** allow directed sends to a session without granting transcript access. (#164444)
- **Worker-local inference:** add a native worker inference runtime with Gateway dispatch, client placement, required worker policy and destination checks before local inference, and clear setup-failure explanations. (#158902, #163645, #163646, #163647, #166611, #166613, #165960) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Device joins:** the CLI and Control UI join command now installs a background node service that can host agent sessions (`--service --session-host`), with a command-only service alternative, and already-paired devices get a working command to enable session hosting. (#168623) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Public threads:** open public threads at their regular links. (#166049)
- **Subagent progress:** count running subagents on the working line, name launched subagents in the operations group, and continue a resumed answer in the block that handed off. (#165477, #165725, #165542) Thanks @shakkernerd.
- **X channel:** add the X (Twitter) mentions channel plugin with Activity API streaming and backfill, repository-question guest mode with hidden same-agent helpers, GitHub-verified repository writers, and daily and monthly X API cost limits. (#165138, #165337, #165376, #165354, #165543, #168071, #165351) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Automation repair:** let a failing automation's owner conversation repair it before alerting, give a second repair turn when the error changes, and post a clear warning when a repair turn times out. (#161007, #162702, #162772) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Channel progress:** show useful Telegram and Discord progress by default, add per-tool glyphs to Discord progress drafts, restore per-tool emoji on Telegram tool rows, and hide routine Slack reaction rows. (#166861, #168032, #167392, #166880) Thanks @obviyus, @keshavbotagent, and @notmnp.
- **Skills:** keep learned skills focused on repeatable procedures rather than facts or codebase knowledge, and keep longer legacy Workshop skills manageable. (#167404, #167639) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Memory:** explain why trigger recall is skipped and why embedding responses are rejected, and report managed Ollama and LM Studio embedding readiness. (#164409, #168035, #156483) Thanks @Ayushdevo, @wangmiao0668000666, and @obviyus.
- **Models and catalogs:** show each provider's recommended models first in pickers, publish curated per-provider recommendations in catalog v2, lead NVIDIA recommendations with its featured models, and apply downloaded catalogs without a Gateway restart. (#167370, #166737, #167989, #158000) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Google:** add Gemini 4 Argon and Gemini 3.8 Flash, and make Gemini 4 Argon the default Google model. (#171852, #172339)
- **Anthropic and Claude CLI:** show newly listed Claude models without waiting for an OpenClaw release, list each Claude CLI model once, and keep logged-out Claude CLI models listed with a login reason. (#167658, #166311, #166338, #167942) Thanks @obviyus.
- **OpenAI:** support custom realtime voice endpoints, show account chat models missing from the manifest, surface new ChatGPT-login models without a release, and stop offering ChatGPT-only or bundled-Codex-rejected models that would fail. (#165632, #162563, #167387, #167633, #167975) Thanks @jacobtomlinson, @obviyus, and @RomneyDa.
- **Codex runtime compatibility:** plugin admission rejects official Codex runtimes below 2026.9.7 with update and repair guidance, and incompatible plugins stay inspectable without being imported. (#168930, #168748, #168749, #168977) Thanks @ezimerman and @RomneyDa.
- **Context limits:** status shows corrected context limits after model discovery, and llama.cpp keeps live router model limits and tools on refresh. (#165991, #168309) Thanks @snotty, @saju01, and @RomneyDa.
- **Tool rows and subagent progress:** show Tool Search calls in native tool rows with shared tool icons across clients, show the subagent wait in place without handoff markers, and guide users after HTTP 400 prompt-size rejections. (#165095, #165378, #159712) Thanks @shakkernerd, @sunlit-deng, and @RomneyDa.
- **Voice calls:** add per-call briefs, call reports, live steering, callbacks, and voicemail detection to voice calls. (#165716) Thanks @mbelinky and @jacobtomlinson.
- **Control UI subagents:** show when a chat is waiting on subagents, open the Subagents panel from the chat's subagent count and names, and surface child failures and attention in the parent chat. (#164190, #166142, #166224, #166312, #166347) Thanks @shakkernerd and @vincentkoc.
- **Control UI customization:** let themes customize Control UI branding, use agent avatars or unlocked Lobsterdex icons for browser tabs, choose favicon shapes, and add seven Lobsterdex character variants. (#168027, #165201, #166325, #167809, #159815) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski, @jacobtomlinson, and @hannesrudolph.
- **Terminal:** add configurable terminal fonts with built-in Nerd Font icons. (#166180) Thanks @jacobtomlinson.
- **Control UI navigation:** copy file paths from chat tooltips, pin agents directly from the switcher, make agent menus easier to scan, let users hide a session's branch PR row, and simplify optional question cards. (#164431, #165640, #165641, #166366, #168040, #150587) Thanks @jjjhenriksen, @vyctorbrzezowski, and @RomneyDa.
- **Skill Workshop:** show each skill with its changes, files, and history in one view. (#167440) Thanks @obviyus.
- **iOS:** connect the Gateway through native Cloudflare Access with app-owned browser and profile admission. (#147244, #147238) Thanks @vincentkoc, @Solvely-Colin, @Patrick-Erichsen, and @RomneyDa.
- **ClawHub:** browse and search ClawHub plugins and skills through the Gateway. (#163459) Thanks @jacobtomlinson.
- **Plugins:** let plugin tools deliver their finished reply without a second model turn, allow every loaded plugin its own queue modes, and select plugin-owned self-hosted executors. (#164558, #165965, #161609) Thanks @mbelinky and @sjf-oa.
- **Plugins:** pick the newest official plugin release the running OpenClaw supports and keep a working plugin when its matching release is unavailable. (#167485, #166588) Thanks @charlesBerg-ux.
- **Workboard:** pin, unpin, and delete boards from the sidebar, keep card notes selectable with a roomier notes editor, and keep column edits on rename. (#165020, #166625, #167348) Thanks @rogeriochaves, @llmsommelier, and @obviyus.
- **GitHub:** support asynchronous PR merges and compact the Publish PR card. (#163579, #165219) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- **Session performance:** serve per-turn session projections, entry reads, authority checks, compaction reads, and first-turn headers from worker threads to keep the Gateway main thread responsive. (#164779, #165028, #165205, #165406, #165401, #165581, #165819, #165027, #165367, #164747, #164989, #165073)
- **Session list and search performance:** stop Control UI list refresh bursts, bound list materialization, scope and prefilter transcript search, speed up cold suggestion lists, and retain previews across metadata edits. (#162280, #164764, #165080, #165089, #165570, #165150, #165834, #165096, #165932, #166635, #165887, #167909) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Turn database performance:** reduce SQLite statements, worker requests, and redundant reads per chat turn, batch snapshot and metadata queries, and reuse admitted schema and reader facts. (#164490, #166041, #166053, #166054, #166074, #166102, #166541, #166503, #166519, #166698, #167278, #167686, #167685, #167690, #167932, #167046, #166966, #166925, #167291, #166703, #167029, #165360, #165193)
- **State database performance:** speed up cold agent database admission and crash recovery, reuse integrity checks on clean restarts, stop reopening executors when switching agents, and release leases promptly during shutdown. (#164846, #165070, #165186, #165293, #165680, #166112, #165993, #167001, #168008, #164788, #164962, #165085, #165910, #166822) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Maintenance and history performance:** lighten idle and manual maintenance, lifecycle cleanup, archive, reset, and trajectory retention work, and speed history reads with nested tool activity. (#164851, #164755, #164938, #165081, #165082, #165254, #165090, #165074, #165274, #165678, #167268, #167070, #167549, #167643, #168013, #167449, #165221, #165181, #165093, #165086, #165111, #165377, #165495, #165909, #166069, #166631, #166778, #166804, #167434, #167915, #167959) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen, @obviyus, and @DonnieFi.
- **Agent performance:** reduce retained heap, per-turn prompt allocations, transcript reads, and main-thread SQLite work during runs, preserve prompt cache across instruction refreshes and image cleanup, and reuse verified history images across turns. (#167454, #167922, #167682, #167547, #167698, #167613, #167355, #165142, #165404, #167282, #164685, #165012, #165410, #165370, #165552) Thanks @RomneyDa and @DonnieFi.
- **Model catalog performance:** speed up multi-provider catalog refreshes, avoid discovery on cold account reads and unrequested plugin catalogs, retain account catalogs during refresh, and reduce catalog worker heap. (#167101, #167334, #167359, #167009, #167008, #166007, #166434, #165911, #165708, #165547, #165034, #165491, #166602) Thanks @vincentkoc, @obviyus, and @xialonglee.
- **Subagent and ACP performance:** reduce startup registry restore latency, move bulk registry work off the Gateway thread, batch registry cohorts, and avoid full-session scans when resuming ACP sessions. (#165942, #165684, #165098, #167684, #167010, #167372, #165550, #167086) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Update performance:** updates stop rehashing unchanged runtime files while retaining the running updater and publishing the candidate, reducing update I/O. (#168958)

### Fixes

- **Gateway memory:** Gateway startup memory is back in the 2026.10.4 range: on a cold start, memory indexes open on the first search or turn that needs them instead of all at once after readiness, catalog, SQLite broker, and transcript worker heaps are capped, and memory search workers used by `openclaw agent` and memory recall retain less memory. (#174718, #172392) Thanks @RomneyDa, @xialonglee, @DonnieFi, @jjjhenriksen, and @jacobtomlinson.
- **Session data safety:** preserve user input and committed facts through restart recovery and failed publication, keep accepted locked appends settled before releasing the writer, and fence cross-store worker commits. (#165502, #167570, #165894, #168018, #168029)
- **Security boundaries:** fail closed when the process census cannot prove a temp root is unused, reject incompatible worker prompt contexts before launch, keep browser pairing credentials out of opener process arguments, expand `file:` SQLite targets before the exec live-state guard checks them, require approval before setup diagnostics repair state, run plugin `before_tool_call` hooks under `openclaw agent exec`, and reject oversized local workspace document saves. (#165079, #166268, #170289, #170253, #171960, #159333, #171938) Thanks @Dhotei, @vincentkoc, @obviyus, @eleqtrizit, @joseairosa, and @RomneyDa.
- **Tool Search provenance:** network results reached through Tool Search and Code Mode now taint the turn the same way direct network tool calls do. (#169560) Thanks @RomneyDa and @farisoftfry.
- **Command owners:** Discord and Slack honor `discord:user:<id>` and `slack:user:<id>` command owners for voice access and exec approvals, so owner-derived approvers are no longer dropped. (#172385, #172424) Thanks @yetval and @RomneyDa.
- **Session authority and privacy:** check caller authority before restoring cold history for compaction, keep authority current after committed session changes, reject malformed hook session keys, and hide pre-session edits to branch-added files from uncommitted diffs. (#166506, #167875, #166406, #164671) Thanks @yetval, @obviyus, and @RomneyDa.
- **Session cleanup:** remove leftover GitHub publication receipts and managed worktrees on cleanup and Incognito reset, and publish conversation, plugin-state, sandbox, worktree, and GitHub authority receipts. (#163833, #165185, #167731, #168025) Thanks @jayzhou2309 and @obviyus.
- **Turn reliability:** stop unrelated session writes from failing Codex and chat turns, keep Knowledge calls working while a session publishes its bookkeeping, and stop group turns from failing silently when history cannot load. (#165196, #166010, #166758, #135253, #166059) Thanks @jalehman, @izshaw, @DonnieFi, and @RomneyDa.
- **Restart recovery:** settle sessions left running after restart, avoid duplicate recovery after ordinary interruptions, keep recovery reconciliation on the host, and preserve database admission, custody, and hook retries for post-restart and first-session turns. (#165174, #154175, #166395, #166867, #166609, #167629, #165859, #165738, #166891) Thanks @Grynn and @RomneyDa.
- **Restart resume:** resume Control UI turns interrupted by a Gateway restart, keep a new session's first message when the Gateway restarts during worktree preparation, resume tasks after deferred startup recovery, resume turns interrupted while a session was still preparing, return interrupted subagents to their parent with their history (including quiet children of parents created by the `agent` RPC), resume automation and node-hosted turns instead of failing with an active turn claim, keep streamed text from a killed native worker in history, keep symlinked state directories working after restart, and settle restart intents and update reports in workers. (#165333, #166042, #165184, #168650, #169144, #170162, #170161, #170223, #168361, #167572, #165069, #165670, #175278) Thanks @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, and @jjjhenriksen.
- **Main session restarts:** main sessions that were mid-turn during a Gateway restart resume on the next boot, and interrupted completion replies are delivered instead of lost. (#168651, #167814, #167766) Thanks @goutamadwant, @marknilsn, @DonnieFi, and @RomneyDa.
- **Agent and session creation:** fix cold shared-store and fresh-store creation failures and agent database recovery after orphan session window repair. (#167257, #167515, #167366, #166860) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Windows and path aliases:** canonicalize the shared state database path and compare link-stable identities so Windows and POSIX path aliases share one store and channel lifecycle. (#166755, #166062, #166787) Thanks @taihartman and @RomneyDa.
- **SQLite deadlocks and stalls:** prevent writer-reader admission and cleanup deadlocks, keep committed reads responsive during writer stalls, stop writer-held transcript reads waiting on readers, and keep foreign changes visible during refresh. (#167662, #167446, #167901, #167687, #166331, #165898, #167332) Thanks @sasan1200, @vincentkoc, and @DonnieFi.
- **State and updates:** stop leftover update-check caches and completed recovery history from blocking updates, and give one actionable answer for state written by a newer release while keeping status reads read-only. (#165461, #167358, #166963) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Startup and integrity checks:** return pending admission during startup index repair, retain integrity proof through startup and idle retirement, and stop healthy starts logging SQLite lock-wait warnings. (#165323, #166972, #166412, #167754, #166253, #168310) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Session search and history:** search transcripts for configured ACP owners, stop false indexing notices, keep search parallel with accurate indexing, preserve dot-prefixed checkpoint references and CLI history after interrupted progress replies, keep canonical transcript owners distinct, and refresh empty previews after cold history is restored. (#164897, #165879, #167174, #167163, #164920, #166658, #164512, #168397) Thanks @sunlit-deng, @obviyus, @techdou, @shakkernerd, @VACInc, and @RomneyDa.
- **Session display:** stop Markdown link markup leaking into previews, show correct context windows for plugin-discovered models, log failed wakes with their target, keep owning agents in lifecycle commands and trajectory export, and decode UTF-16 BOM text files. (#166653, #159731, #166458, #166415, #165777) Thanks @jayzhou2309, @obviyus, @rudycelekli, @Yigtwxx, @yetval, and @RomneyDa.
- **Startup ordering:** stop agents with small transcript rebuild backlogs from waiting behind larger agents at startup. (#165207)
- **Data integrity:** reject malformed UTF-8 backup manifests before verification, preserve malformed UTF-8 and trailing-space connect targets, and keep accents in named legacy text attachments. (#167389, #167399, #167116, #165405) Thanks @Alix-007, @obviyus, and @Chessing234.
- **Turn lifecycle:** publish one terminal event per stopped or runtime-lost run, settle terminal runs before session mutations, keep queued message run ids and replies aligned, prevent internal recovery errors after queued turns, and keep follow-ups queued after stopping a turn during preparation. (#165483, #167383, #166784, #166981, #165996, #164656, #172685) Thanks @RomneyDa, @shakkernerd, and @jjjhenriksen.
- **Stop and steering:** stop yielded commands with their Gateway request, retire stopped continuations, allow wakes after stopped commands, preserve running tools when steering receipts are uncertain, show accepted steering messages in order, and hold steering during worktree creation until the task finishes. (#166753, #166775, #166968, #166754, #168099, #165462, #165537) Thanks @shakkernerd, @RomneyDa, and @DonnieFi.
- **Queue fairness:** prevent background starvation under sustained traffic, avoid stalled turns when diagnostics throw, and keep permit waiters until their real deadline. (#167683, #167733, #165359) Thanks @Chessing234.
- **Chat delivery:** deliver activity-summary updates after compaction, hide managed media directives in CR-only replies, keep node completion follow-ups in their originating conversation, preserve live node approval handoffs, and stop false Yield failed warnings in group chats. (#165024, #164657, #160675, #166971, #161154, #166396) Thanks @ly85206559, @obviyus, @brokemac79, @jjjhenriksen, and @RomneyDa.
- **Session creation:** keep new sessions working while other local turns start or finish, recognize agents immediately after agents.create, keep parent-only sessions bound to their agent, and bind required worker sessions during workspace binding. (#165984, #167894, #165929, #167162) Thanks @alkor2000, @markstones78, and @RomneyDa.
- **Chat history:** stop endless retries for sessions in skipped agent stores, return anchored history for pre-reset Claude CLI-bound messages, retain tool history details and channel startup context, keep generated and truncated session titles UTF-16 safe and balanced, and keep channel messages in session history when required preflight compaction fails. (#165408, #166578, #164848, #141240, #167584, #160462) Thanks @obviyus, @VACInc, @sjf-oa, @sjf, @hugenshen, @cursoragent, @masatohoshino, and @RomneyDa.
- **Claude CLI and helper calls:** route shorthand Anthropic CLI auth refs correctly, keep the session observer working on CLI-backed utility models, keep OpenClaw helper calls working across runtime changes, and avoid a Claude CLI startup event deadlock. (#84374, #162067, #166235, #173011) Thanks @joshavant, @obviyus, @rogeriochaves, @llmsommelier, @PollyBot13, @ericcaiwx-star, and @sopa-gpters.
- **Models and catalog:** keep Codex selectable after startup and deferred agent startup, recheck models after failed catalog recovery, keep OpenRouter and LM Studio thinking levels intact, and keep Gateway startup alive when a model refresh is replaced mid-start. (#165979, #166081, #162901, #166705, #164478, #164597, #173366) Thanks @scotthuang, @obviyus, @ooiuuii, @VACInc, @RomneyDa, and @jjjhenriksen.
- **Usage and metrics:** report usage for silent replies, estimate context when compatible streams omit usage, include background utility completions in token and cost metrics, keep usage ranges ordered when the host skipped a date, and correct the Sonnet 5.5 cache-read cost. (#152396, #166151, #167986, #165523, #164140, #171723) Thanks @ly85206559, @obviyus, @MutenCath, @fede-kamel, @ericcurtin, @etzelm, @SashaMIT, @DasX, and @vincentkoc.
- **Startup and readiness:** show startup failures even when cleanup fails, stop small agents waiting on larger agents, prevent public chat 503s and stalls after startup, avoid failures during temporary state contention, stop Gateway start reporting success before an existing process is ready, keep fresh macOS profiles starting the Gateway and running automatic setup, and let the Gateway start on current Kubernetes images. (#164500, #165107, #167604, #166111, #166942, #167697, #167674, #173246, #172377) Thanks @sunlit-deng, @obviyus, @waynegault, @NianJiuZst, @ericcaiwx-star, @mashaohua1999-stack, @RomneyDa, @saftall, and @DonnieFi.
- **Gateway resilience:** keep WebSocket connections open after handler errors, keep startup alive under the V8 contradiction exit mode, stop config saves hanging after the watcher applies secret references, keep wizard step authority through setup-inference probes, stop replies that mention tool calls from stalling the event loop while streaming, and stop the Gateway pinning a CPU and ignoring SIGTERM after the log date rolls over on a deleted `/tmp`. (#171303, #171490, #171922, #171667, #172631, #160433) Thanks @RomneyDa, @enter501, @JasonBuildAI, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, and @WadeOwenWatts.
- **Gateway lifecycle:** state reads stay closed until restart after a failed state cleanup, database admission no longer blocks worker startup, lifecycle publications survive after the emitting producer drains, and Android/Termux Gateways no longer fail with "shared-state database generation changed". (#171709, #170348, #170231, #167719) Thanks @RomneyDa, @residentb2b, @yxshee, @grabowskidaniel359-design, @DonnieFi, and @jjjhenriksen.
- **Plugins and restarts:** retry stuck plugin reloads once their work settles, and keep Control UI reconnects from freezing the Gateway during plugin reloads. (#164894) Thanks @obviyus and @DonnieFi.
- **Status and diagnostics:** stop deep status blaming config for an unreadable state database, report startup migrations and channel logouts accurately, surface startup failures over unrelated log lines, use plain language for diagnostic checks, stop recommending onboarding for runtime failures, and report signal-terminated node commands. (#167352, #167723, #167478, #166946, #165742, #166234, #165116, #165358, #165426) Thanks @RomneyDa, @PollyBot13, @obviyus, @Colton-Harris, and @shakkernerd.
- **Daemon and platforms:** avoid versioned pnpm launcher paths, keep exec and MCP servers working after a Homebrew Node upgrade, reconnect Apple clients promptly after network changes, keep node command lookup after a Finder or Dock launch on macOS, preserve multiline LaunchAgent environment values, unblock PATH discovery when login startup ignores termination, and refresh legacy group-writable systemd units during upgrades. (#166222, #166430, #168024, #171460, #171740, #169507, #172790) Thanks @jayzhou2309, @mightyx, @brianmcguire, @jamiezigelbaum, @yetval, @zhangguiping-xydt, @obviyus, @wei887-os, and @RomneyDa.
- **Networking:** restore managed portals on large Tailscale tailnets, keep verified Tailscale GitHub users signed in during GitHub rate limits, and bound unattributable proxy warnings. (#165507, #166254, #134404) Thanks @obviyus, @redasadki, @LeizhenZhang, and @abacha.
- **Workers and processes:** stop repeated worker starts after initialization failure, keep workspace recovery running during unrelated writes, stop background execs outliving cleanup, load source workspace workers from external directories, release settled work blocking suspension, and avoid heap-check stalls in busy Bun Gateways. (#165277, #166375, #166478, #166606, #165871, #167184, #166104, #166608, #162124) Thanks @Oldrich333, @RomneyDa, @michaelswissa, @obviyus, and @DonnieFi.
- **Gateway behavior:** encode Ctrl+Space and modified function keys in send-keys, collapse finished processes by default, cap oversized policy watch intervals, keep slow WebSocket response logs and stop listener buildup, keep OpenAI-compatible cancellations from blaming the provider, and keep `logs.tail` cost proportional to the requested window. (#164688, #164776, #164850, #164772, #165052, #167995, #172885) Thanks @yetval, @obviyus, @shakkernerd, @KrasimirKralev, and @etzelm.
- **Integrations:** parse Firecrawl source-specific results, report ComfyUI workflows without outputs, validate meeting timeouts, stop Mattermost retrying permanent refusals, and include jobId in agent_end hook context for scheduled runs. (#155885, #166249, #158695, #167244, #167124) Thanks @qingminglong, @obviyus, @chelsealong, @catnipluss, @Alix-007, @Leon-SK668, and @xyrolle.
- **Workspaces:** reconcile root node workspaces and surface failures, reject timed-out workspace inventory commands, keep paired nodes' scheduled workspace retention and worker-bundle publication from aborting after each scheduler tick, and allow Claw removal with a running Gateway. (#166441, #167673, #168780, #166889) Thanks @RomneyDa.

- **macOS and Windows:** fence recovery installs with the runtime pin, size LaunchAgent exit timeouts, install unattended Windows Gateway tasks, replace running services safely, and save macOS downloads instead of displaying archive bytes. (#165044, #165320, #166510, #165163, #165261, #165538, #164680, #173654) Thanks @yuzh086-create, @desksk, and @Patrick-Erichsen.
- **Markdown and text:** keep wrapped frontmatter values, preserve prose between operator tokens, and avoid tiny code messages from rendering overhead. (#165531, #165753, #167958) Thanks @SashaMIT, @obviyus, and @Sedrak-Hovhannisyan.
- **Local models:** show embedding-only setup when llama.cpp chat exceeds RAM. (#165832) Thanks @obviyus and @NovaUnboundAi.
- **GitHub Copilot:** fix first turns for Chat Completions-only and new Claude models. (#167941) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Logging and secrets:** stop restarts from logging false secret-resolution failures. (#165485)
- **Config:** reject malformed UTF-8 and malformed plugin metadata JSON before rewriting files, explain blocked destructive updates, and stop recommending refused writes for managed metadata. (#167118, #167391, #155427, #166830) Thanks @Alix-007, @obviyus, @RomneyDa, and @sxh313.
- **Auth:** preserve selected chat accounts when credentials disappear, keep concurrent Gateway calls authenticated, fix Claude CLI plugin completions returning 401 without a selected profile, and point retired auth profile migrations at doctor --fix. (#166985, #166523, #166173, #167650) Thanks @vincentkoc, @sunlit-deng, @Fealves0, @samson1357924, and @RomneyDa.
- **Pairing:** tell browsers when their access request is declined or expires. (#164793)
- **Plugin SDK compatibility:** published plugins that import private runtime exports from JavaScript-only `openclaw/plugin-sdk` facades load again, and plugins built against 2026.10.1 and 2026.10.2 can import `createSessionHeaderLink` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/control-ui` again; both are deprecated compatibility exports. (#173777, #169746) Thanks @RomneyDa and @FtlC-ian.
- **Skills:** ready macOS skills are included in agent prompts. (#172214) Thanks @fhgffy.
- **Update safety:** complete package swaps across devices instead of rolling back on EXDEV, judge publication and rollback identity on the published bytes, keep foreign-owned state roots writable, and keep busy Gateway agent writes from refusing updates. (#164769, #164797, #164823, #164990, #172196) Thanks @potterdigital, @saftall, @RomneyDa, and @DonnieFi.
- **Update recovery:** settle pending recoveries after a lost or replaced lease database, recover updates blocked by missing handoff leases, stop completed recovery history from blocking future updates, settle package-activation journals after filesystem remounts and device-number drift, keep the recovery deadline monotonic across wall-clock jumps, and preserve state when a legacy Doctor rehearsal fails. (#167302, #165238, #165607, #167330, #164997, #169410, #170046, #169168, #171015) Thanks @shanselman, @Hensarj, @NovaeonStudio, @RomneyDa, @patrickschiller, @SergeiAug, @SunnyShu0925, @Bamorem, and @jjjhenriksen.
- **Update and Gateway restarts:** restart the Gateway and record the interruption when the updater is signaled mid-activation, stop managed systemd Gateways with the bounded gateway-stop sequence, refuse before mutating masked units, keep restart authority through brief post-update maintenance contention, wait for native Gateway ownership before restarting, and stop updates stalling on an unhealthy incumbent Gateway. (#165863, #167040, #165747, #167760, #171699, #173588, #173358) Thanks @jlapenna, @gregb100, @fdovarela, @obviyus, and @RomneyDa.
- **Update on Windows and macOS:** refuse non-elevated Windows updates immediately with an elevation hint, keep macOS updates from timing out on aliased temporary directories, finish repairing the bundled macOS Gateway during update recovery, leave pacman-owned installations to their package manager, allow macOS updates from login shells when containment is verified, and run pnpm from its own install during macOS pnpm updates. (#166695, #169860, #171508, #169055, #172640, #171936) Thanks @RomneyDa, @Pegorim, @giulianoaccorsi, @AntaresGG, and @DonnieFi.
- **Update compatibility:** preserve startup errors and admit Doctor runs from older updaters, keep the 2026.10.1 updater's cleanup queue across replacement, and repair legacy config on identical-package updates. (#162344, #168883, #165242) Thanks @jamiezigelbaum, @RomneyDa, @shakkernerd, and @DonnieFi.
- **No-restart updates:** `openclaw update --no-restart` on npm, pnpm, and Bun installs warns before the package swap and records a successful update instead of a failure, without verifying the old build while the package is replaced, and plugin activation guidance is kept after core-changing `--no-restart` updates. (#173409, #174649, #171687) Thanks @RomneyDa and @mwbroxson.
- **Update outcomes:** finish verified updates despite channel probe errors, keep a settled completion refresh failure from failing a successful update, settle a verified completed publication during admission, keep database rollback available when candidate Doctor fails before writing, defer Doctor instead of rolling back when update-driver ancestry is unverified, avoid rollback when post-plugin lint cannot finish, and refresh service definitions even when the config snapshot is large. (#172494, #172502, #171993, #172151, #172247, #173341, #170373) Thanks @SBC2016, @teetee2tone, @RomneyDa, @homeworld520, @yoyo837, and @DonnieFi.
- **Update diagnostics:** name each candidate and preflight check, the resolved install, and the detected runtime when refusing, surface the child's refusal reason through the managed handoff, record why handoffs failed, show every recorded update warning, clarify report wording, and point migrated-state failures to `openclaw update repair`. (#164746, #166410, #164782, #166540, #167509, #167802, #167794, #164858, #166577, #168905) Thanks @TOM-WANG-GUANG, @coygeek, @GitHoubi, @Patrick-Erichsen, @xydigitLybnnnn, @creanet-64, and @RomneyDa.
- **Update verification:** degrade candidate verification at integrity limits instead of refusing, treat channel health-collection timeouts as warnings, finish deferred model repair, honor an explicit TMPDIR, and stop triage retry loops. (#164504, #165852, #165148, #165830, #167051, #165982, #167035) Thanks @vasaeru, @DonnieFi, and @WG-Mojo.
- **Update and Doctor:** update repair turns no longer abort mid-update while reading config, update repair no longer fails after Doctor completes on busy macOS hosts, update repair prepares its config before inference, Doctor no longer fails after short commands complete, Doctor lint is no longer deferred with no time left after a slow state snapshot, schema inspection keeps running under progress backpressure, Docker upgrades stop retry loops on older Linux hosts, Doctor explains plugin migration backup coverage, and updates recover when another user owns shared temp storage. (#170779, #170276, #172132, #170374, #170955, #162305, #169295, #170174) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @yxshee, @Ludwigtheo0815, @holgergruenhagen, and @jjjhenriksen.
- **Update cleanup and exit:** Doctor cleanup during updates no longer fails with nested-effect errors, unsafe Doctor recovery guidance is kept until settled, and a completed update whose result reporting fails exits with its warning instead of opening interactive failure triage. (#170070, #168750, #170207, #169422, #168587) Thanks @hannesrudolph, @ezimerman, @angeliti999, @jjjhenriksen, and @DonnieFi.
- **Install:** preserve npm network environment settings and fix Windows Bun packaging failing to find npm. (#165409, #165241) Thanks @Chessing234.
- **Doctor migrations:** commit transcript archive migration per batch, preserve SQLite files and markerless legacy cron ownership, and settle migrations whose owner is unavailable. (#165837, #166671, #166996, #167059, #162275) Thanks @RomneyDa and @jaiden0.
- **Doctor backups:** keep the pre-migration backup when sqlite-vec cannot load, write captures on filesystems that reject RENAME_NOREPLACE, and retain interrupted capture evidence. (#165820, #166425, #164748, #166495) Thanks @NovaUnboundAi, @MertBasar0, @bbs2i58, @hippoley, and @RomneyDa.
- **Doctor and Gateway:** verify restarted Gateways by health, avoid races with a managed Gateway, settle Doctor writers before recovery, exit 141 only when Doctor's own output closes, stop Doctor stalling on missing transcripts with a stale import receipt, and stop false transcript mismatch reports for imported legacy sessions with media. (#167713, #166948, #162614, #171780, #172890, #171388) Thanks @RomneyDa, @lshamash, @dtump, @DongwonGim, @he-yufeng, @brookpw, and @obviyus.
- **Doctor accuracy:** keep lint and JSON Doctor read-only, run diagnostics when maintenance is declined, stop promising service defaults it cannot apply, and resolve the Claude CLI binary like the runtime. (#166857, #168065, #166950, #165273, #166384, #167699) Thanks @RomneyDa, @mightyx, @jayzhou2309, and @davidchyi-beep.
- **Doctor data safety:** Doctor refuses retired state before migrating the database, imports retained ACP metadata after archiving legacy session stores, restores a stopped Gateway when cleanup fails, and removes the `(multiple)` store sentinel registered as an agent database. (#170051, #169918, #169759, #169783, #170043, #169764) Thanks @bautrey, @RomneyDa, @ourcoms2018, and @DonnieFi.
- **Skill Workshop:** keep approval-first setups from writing skills unreviewed while keeping automatic learning for approval-policy configs. (#167641, #167846) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Plugins on Windows:** stop Gateway startup stalls capturing installed plugin files, preserve native SDK filenames, keep Bun plugins across source edits, and reclaim Jiti generation caches. (#168313, #165282, #165533, #165169) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Plugin loading:** resolve mixed-case plugin IDs, load Doctor contracts after in-place replacement, preserve replacement installs across watcher echoes, reload bundled plugins with dormant records, and settle migrations whose owner is unavailable. (#164683, #165049, #166618, #167647, #165861, #163198, #164662) Thanks @mbelinky, @Franklinyung, @shakkernerd, and @RomneyDa.
- **Plugin runtime:** keep plugin-started turns' completion status, fix Copilot plugin tool calls after the first turn, keep isolated completions from capturing unrelated plugins, and fix follow-up turns after native tool use. (#167621, #164598, #166310, #168067, #163636) Thanks @ericcurtin, @obviyus, @takyyon, @jjjhenriksen, and @RomneyDa.
- **Plugin diagnostics:** use plain language for diagnostic and connection checks and stop repeating unchanged provenance warnings. (#165741, #165740, #167023) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Message tool:** keep replies when ClawHub finds no matches. (#166452) Thanks @a6xa3 and @obviyus.
- **CLI:** prevent silent status hangs, keep Gateway readiness on a monotonic clock, and prevent rapid log polling. (#167677, #155799, #163791, #164998) Thanks @RomneyDa, @SunnyShu0925, @LinzeShi, @obviyus, and @Grynn.
- **CLI output:** return JSON errors for node, exec-policy, and devices refusals, explain unresolvable agent model references and reasoning-only model runs, reject ACP harness models for ACP agents, and show a UTC marker in sessions tail. (#167437, #167279, #167294, #168009, #156137, #166662, #148022, #145537, #145532, #166745, #164835) Thanks @Leon-SK668, @obviyus, @masatohoshino, @azuretek, @taekop, @jayzhou2309, @FtlC-ian, @TUARAN, @aniruddhaadak80, @hugenshen, @altaywtf, @sxh313, and @danhayman.
- **Shell completion:** preserve escaped profile spaces and Fish completion backslashes, and restore PowerShell completion for quoted option values. (#164785, #164455, #167421) Thanks @yetval, @obviyus, and @LinzeShi.
- **Worktrees:** create parallel New Session worktrees concurrently, preserve worktrees used by live sessions, recover leaked branches, stop repeated Git maintenance failures, heal missing commit-graph tips and stale pack indexes, and use remote defaults after fetch failures. (#166060, #166443, #164615, #165204, #167473, #165995, #167426, #167691, #167367, #165969) Thanks @jjjhenriksen and @RomneyDa.
- **Workboard:** keep automation, home, and Board agent sessions off Sessions boards, show truthful run and PR facts, explain dispatch refusals, stop re-dispatch from silently using an old base, and keep fallback runs active until the overall outcome settles. (#165076, #165319, #165189, #167427, #164829, #168215, #167574) Thanks @Leon-SK668, @obviyus, @mightyx, @ArcueidMP, @skyzhao1223, and @asikorskiy.
- **Agents API sessions:** saved remote sessions continue with the same session ID across binding upgrades. (#168150)
- **Large Gateways:** large fleets reserve session stores without stack overflows, and process-owning Gateway stops no longer wait on native skills watcher cleanup. (#168354, #168160, #168273) Thanks @609NFT, @obviyus, and @DonnieFi.
- **Gateway performance:** acknowledge chat sends before skill preparation, restore fast saved-session model picking, retain cold session list selections, reduce board and member-list read latency, prewarm sandbox templates, and avoid premature scheduler wakes and full placement projections. (#165608, #166037, #166405, #166403, #165344, #165125, #165931, #165922, #165600, #165840, #166617, #167666, #167813, #166387, #165015) Thanks @obviyus and @jacobtomlinson.
- **Gateway performance:** serve chat, usage, placement, and metadata reads from workers and prepared projections, move startup maintenance and notice sweeping after readiness, and reduce SQLite, projection, and history-page work per chat turn. (#164744, #164943, #165470, #165614, #165218, #165331, #166587, #167194, #167032, #166263, #165190, #166365) Thanks @obviyus, @DonnieFi, and @RomneyDa.
- **Gateway performance:** speed up reconnects, restarts, and bootstrap by sharing update status, reusing admitted state and snapshots, warming recent database pages, and pausing reconnect bootstrap during restarts. (#164984, #165498, #165667, #165545, #165524, #165782, #165480, #167407, #164670, #165803, #166018, #166122) Thanks @DonnieFi.
- **Gateway performance:** share opted-in reads and broadcast encoding across clients, reuse catalogs, session rows, avatars, and artifact summaries, bound link previews and queued previews, and keep PR comparisons local. (#165203, #167961, #162326, #165941, #165464, #166591, #166429, #165759, #166195, #166474, #166461, #166264, #165030, #166447)
- **Worker performance:** reduce worker scheduling, transport, and reader memory overhead, centralize bounded pool sizing, expose cost attribution, and cut Gateway fork costs for Git and TLS. (#165077, #165230, #165249, #167295, #167060, #167676, #165816, #165290, #164465, #166683, #167235)
- **Performance:** move cron ticks, session scans, maintenance, and run transcripts off the main thread, share skill indexes, offload memory retrieval and index admission, persist sandbox state through workers, and serve channel status from recorded health. (#165332, #165511, #165629, #167248, #163885, #166507, #165106, #165173, #167644, #167254, #165075, #165568, #165611, #165558, #165534, #165295, #165436, #166538, #164694, #164648) Thanks @vincentkoc, @obviyus, @kzclaw, and @Patrick-Erichsen.
- **Performance:** speed up chat with indexed reads, bounded history pages, reused metadata, catalogs, and versioned assets, smaller tool previews, and fewer idle reads. (#164605, #165897, #166250, #167993, #168023, #167896, #167906, #167968, #167020, #167447, #167263, #167238, #165101, #165228, #163573, #166493, #165546) Thanks @shakkernerd, @boeingchoco, and @obviyus.
- **Update performance:** skip unnecessary fetches for cached commits, unused state leases, duplicate snapshots, and slow prevalidation of large plugin trees, and reduce inventory latency for large runtimes. (#165060, #165326, #166126, #166317, #166741, #165316, #165013) Thanks @vincentkoc, @hannesrudolph, and @ooiuuii.
- **Worktree and Git performance:** run worktree GC and cleanup in the background with capacity limits, back off timed-out and corrupt-repo cleanup, consolidate shared packs, speed up partial-clone creation, and keep session diffs responsive in large repositories. (#164758, #165913, #167323, #167453, #167944, #165858, #167936, #167030, #167695, #167631, #166072, #165513, #165605, #165750, #165981, #165411, #167899, #166214, #166381) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Workboard and GitHub performance:** skip unchanged card and Sessions board reloads, reuse authorized snapshots, speed up revision reads, and overlap preview and publication option reads. (#165058, #165141, #165698, #165896, #165094, #167189, #167597, #166987, #167322)
- **Plugin and auth performance:** bound retained plugin heap across reloads, reuse instance identity, batch plugin capture copies, move OAuth refresh and auth saves to workers, and run pairing mutations in the SQLite worker. (#166751, #165923, #167516, #166955, #166278, #165029, #159448, #165658, #165644, #166936, #166183, #164992, #166283, #167239, #167308) Thanks @jjjhenriksen, @RomneyDa, and @Patrick-Erichsen.
- **CLI and diagnostics performance:** reuse prepared runtime inputs, calibrate memory pressure to runtime limits, and reduce Prometheus scrape allocation. (#166864, #162313, #165042, #167618, #167930, #166933, #165327) Thanks @sunlit-deng, @obviyus, and @etzelm.

releases.name: openclaw 2026.10.10-beta.1
releases.body:
## 2026.10.10-beta.1

### Highlights

- **Faster, steadier Gateway:** chat turns, session lists, startup, and idle Gateways do far less SQLite and main-thread work, with more database work moved onto worker threads, so busy hosts and large agent fleets stay responsive. (#167965, #168002, #168093, #169005, #169164, #171685, #170151, #169871, #168649, #170612, #171371, #171805, #168992, #169543) Thanks @obviyus, @609NFT, @Leon-SK668, @chelsealong, @RomneyDa, and @joshavant.
- **Updates that finish:** upgrades from 2026.10.1 and earlier betas complete, busy Gateways and slow Doctor steps no longer refuse or roll back a good update, failed updates no longer leave a half-installed version, and macOS, Windows, and Bun installs recover from their platform-specific failures. (#168849, #172249, #172196, #172151, #172247, #171101, #170519, #172640, #171936, #170940, #171077, #172494) Thanks @RomneyDa, @homeworld520, @Yolo521-bot, @giulianoaccorsi, @AntaresGG, @stop-time, @davidcittadini, and @SBC2016.
- **Restart-safe replies:** interrupted and unfinished replies resume after a Gateway restart, and watched child results, queued turns, accepted agent updates, and operator tasks survive restarts instead of disappearing. (#172234, #172412, #169489, #171717, #170697, #170858, #170384, #172356, #172023) Thanks @jeanmonet.
- **Cloud sessions:** move sessions between local and cloud from the session menu, organize cloud environments by repository with environment recipes and verified Node toolchains, and see snapshot progress while sessions start before the first snapshot finishes uploading. (#171690, #170892, #170862, #170796, #170875, #170895, #171729)
- **Local Gateway in the desktop apps:** the Windows desktop app and fresh Tauri installs can run a local Gateway, fresh macOS installs start in guided dashboard setup, and first-run setup chooses inference automatically. (#169522, #169512, #169568, #169628)
- **New models:** Gemini 4 Argon becomes the default Gemini model alongside Gemini 3.8 Flash, Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and xAI Imagine Image 2.0 arrive, Meta models run through Muse Code, and pickers stop offering retired models. (#171852, #172339, #172449, #172445, #170487, #171526, #171879) Thanks @nv-kasikritc, @jacobtomlinson, @JFLeonM, and @obviyus.
- **Newer Apple platforms required:** OpenClaw now requires macOS 26.2, iOS 26.2, and Safari 26.2 or newer. (#168595)

### Changes

- **Apple platform requirement:** require macOS, iOS, and Safari 26.2 or newer for the native apps and Control UI. (#168595)
- **Cloud sessions:** move sessions between local and cloud from session menus, organize cloud environments by repository, support repository environment recipes with verified Node toolchains, save suggested cloud profiles on first use, show snapshot startup progress, start sessions while the first snapshot uploads, ready workers for empty-workspace sessions, report slow dispatch phases, and keep cloud setup secrets behind scoped egress grants. (#171690, #170892, #170862, #170796, #170875, #170895, #171729, #170929, #171749, #171073, #170810) Thanks @VACInc.
- **Desktop apps and first run:** support local Gateways in the Windows desktop app, start fresh Tauri installs with a local Gateway, start fresh macOS installs in guided dashboard setup, guide missing native permissions in chat, and choose inference automatically during first-run setup. (#169522, #169512, #169568, #169635, #169628)
- **Local setup:** offer optional memory embedding setup, add managed llama.cpp OCR and vision setup, and allow non-interactive llama.cpp embedding-only setup. (#163693, #148193, #170153) Thanks @PollyBot13, @duyufansh2008, and @dh-js.
- **Bun runtime:** build standalone OpenClaw executables with Bun, add an opt-in pinned Bun runtime that rejects unpinnable paths before changing anything, and start the Gateway faster on Bun. (#172384, #168832, #168982, #169543) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- **Experimental PostgreSQL:** add an experimental PostgreSQL engine for the Workboard store, select the shared-state engine at its owner, generate PostgreSQL DDL from canonical SQLite schemas, add PostgreSQL migrations with capability admission and exact schema-drift checks, preserve PostgreSQL stores in backups and updates, and add verified offline database port tooling. (#169214, #171962, #168219, #169933, #172265, #170828, #170518, #171368, #171265, #170037, #170055, #170059, #171350, #171484, #171518, #171795, #172046, #171545) Thanks @vincentkoc and @joshavant.
- **Conversations:** organize and archive nested conversations explicitly, choose when sessions can send and receive messages, opt in to `sessions_send` thread targets, run sessions in existing folders on paired devices, and snooze sessions until a custom time. (#168076, #162316, #168846, #169722, #171255) Thanks @VACInc, @obviyus, and @jacobtomlinson.
- **Session personalization:** personalize session backgrounds, add per-session speech bubbles and prompt reactions, show session-specific previews for public links, and match public conversation pages to the chat design with copy buttons. (#168301, #168861, #169527, #168156) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski and @VACInc.
- **Control UI navigation:** organize personal navigation in a compact sidebar rail with real shortcut icons, filter sidebar users by online status, keep New conversation visible across sidebar modes, show session details beside wide conversations, make colored sessions easier to scan, inspect attached automations from session hovercards, put everyday session actions first, and make release updates discoverable from the account menu. (#168325, #168997, #172243, #170771, #170707, #170382, #172240, #168616, #172544, #100024) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev, @shakkernerd, and @VACInc.
- **Control UI chat:** group session context and task progress in Details, clarify the session details inspector, render assistant directives and an embed tag, show readable tweet preview cards, load older history in larger pages, shrink the composer in existing sessions, search emoji by name in the reaction picker, add manual code folding to session diffs, and show or hide values in secure entry prompts. (#161674, #172436, #64104, #168213, #170481, #171637, #172577, #172350, #169925, #172549) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski, @obviyus, @Takhoffman, @Patrick-Erichsen, and @jacobtomlinson.
- **Languages:** add Swedish to the Control UI and docs, and include plugin catalogs in locale refresh. (#62063, #171496) Thanks @yeager and @vincentkoc.
- **Agents API:** choose Agents API hosted workspaces when starting sessions, isolate Agents API sessions from Gateway tools and MCP, and allow shared compaction tuning in hosted sessions. (#168259, #170728, #171813)
- **MCP apps and automations:** use MCP plugin apps across conversations and workspace files, trigger automations from MCP events, connect MCP apps through a principal-bound relay plugin, and support principal-bound remote Control UI for trusted plugins. (#161747, #165399, #168233, #170540)
- **Plugins and SDK:** allow per-run model fallback overrides, fork a session's live context for background side questions, let plugins steer a session's active run, support Solid Control UI views, add worker-owned keyed state and conversation binding APIs, join service and account scheduling at retirement, complete awaited SQLite compatibility migration paths, and show calm notices for deprecated SDK usage. releases.body:
## 2026.10.5-beta.4

### Highlights

- **Updates finish more reliably:** macOS updates no longer time out on aliased temporary directories, systemd user installs reclaim abandoned runtimes, pacman and FreeBSD package installs are left to their package manager, snapshot failures are identified before activation with accurate recovery advice, and the success summary no longer repeats settled plugin upgrades as pending. (#169860, #171488, #169055, #171457, #170351, #170413) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, and @Pegorim.
- **ChatGPT models work on the default Codex runtime:** ChatGPT-listed models no longer fail before sending any request. (#168033) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Headless browser sign-ins stay usable:** headless pages keep accepting clicks and key presses while a site waits for a passkey. (#170857) Thanks @trukhinyuri.

### Changes

- **Context limits:** status shows corrected context limits after model discovery, Copilot honors reported context capacity when native limits are missing, and llama.cpp keeps live router model limits and tools on refresh. (#165991, #156636, #168309) Thanks @snotty, @saju01, and @RomneyDa.

### Fixes

- **Gateway access:** local access keeps working when the tailnet denies Tailscale Serve, and lifecycle publications survive after the emitting producer drains. (#171509, #170231) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **macOS repair and recovery:** update recovery finishes repairing the bundled Gateway, the app keeps a compatible newer Gateway during recovery instead of downgrading it, LaunchAgent repair accepts verified bootstrap recovery, and Doctor allows offline state repair for app-owned Gateways. (#171508, #170766, #170740, #170768) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Update resilience:** updates keep moving when optional cron inspection or snapshot cleanup fails. (#170754) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Security:** Tlon never treats group DM authors as the owner. (#165801) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- **Turns and replies:** Claude CLI sessions remember announced sub-agent results on the next turn, agent plugin reloads no longer wait on their own turn, interrupted turns are preserved when new messages arrive, ACP follow-up replies no longer disappear after the previous turn is stopped, context-engine advancement survives steering, visible sub-agent spawns try the primary model first, and launched agent turns no longer fail with writer claim errors. (#164175, #171257, #170647, #170883, #168394, #169984, #170077) Thanks @robertoronderosjr, @RomneyDa, @etzelm, and @jacobtomlinson.
- **Gateway lifecycle:** the Gateway stays responsive during reply-tagged streams and long quoted tool XML no longer triggers per-token Markdown parsing, blocked context-engine turns stop repeating in the Gateway log on every run, the Control UI no longer reconnects on delayed heartbeats, state reads stay closed until restart after a failed state cleanup, the Gateway recovers state ownership after sleep and clock changes, stalled transcript workers no longer block shutdown, database admission no longer blocks worker startup, shutdown joins lifecycle publication, forced descendant cleanup releases worker capacity, enabled standalone plugin files start with the Gateway, Gateway restart works from verified external macOS terminals, and Android/Termux gateways no longer fail with "shared-state database generation changed". (#166782, #171573, #167595, #171253, #171709, #170790, #170493, #170348, #170555, #168746, #171330, #170354, #167719) Thanks @aniruddhaadak80, @holgergruenhagen, @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @yxshee, @grabowskidaniel359-design, @jjjhenriksen, @AnvinaLI, @sgh6688, @waynegault, @Oldrich333, @residentb2b, @boeingchoco, and @jalehman.
- **Workers:** worker heap limits are enforced under process-wide Node flags. (#166581) Thanks @valkyriweb, @xydigitLybnnnn, @goslingmanagment, and @waynegault.
- **Channels and tools:** MCP OAuth login completes with portless loopback registrations, and each Feishu monitor start gets its own binding adapter registration. (#170876, #169226) Thanks @9fw2pq8sgb-art, @ruel225, @obviyus, and @junniar.
- **Update and Doctor:** update repair no longer fails after Doctor completes on busy macOS hosts, slow update admission no longer holds the database writer and disrupts Gateway work, update repair prepares its config before inference, metadata inventory survives progress-output backpressure, Docker upgrades stop retry loops on older Linux hosts, Doctor explains plugin migration backup coverage, and Doctor no longer logs spurious WAL maintenance warnings while repairing shared state. (#170779, #171493, #170276, #168493, #162305, #169295, #170783) Thanks @vincentkoc, @yxshee, @Ludwigtheo0815, @RomneyDa, and @DonnieFi.
- **Plugin publishing:** plugin npm publication no longer fails when artifact pagination repeats an entry. (#171044) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.5-beta.3..9e0a1c922e978fbcfb14c29d112573f6a99468d7 history: 61 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 61 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

releases.name: openclaw 2026.10.4
releases.body:
## 2026.10.4

### Highlights

- The Gateway keeps running after the computer sleeps or the system clock jumps, instead of restarting itself because its ownership heartbeat looked stale. (#170790) Thanks @AnvinaLI, @sgh6688, @waynegault, and @RomneyDa.
- Gateway shutdown and restart no longer hang on a stalled transcript worker or in-flight session lifecycle events. (#170493, #170555) Thanks @Oldrich333.
- Tlon group DMs no longer treat other participants as the owner, closing an owner-impersonation path. (#165801) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- Headless browser pages keep responding to clicks while a site waits for a passkey. (#170857) Thanks @trukhinyuri.
- Manual `/compact` settles the active run before compacting instead of aborting it and dropping the pending request. (#166163) Thanks @holny and @alexph-dev.

### Changes

- Stability patch for 2026.10.3 with no new features or configuration changes. Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Fixes

- Gateway: stays responsive during long reply-tagged streams, and long replies that quote tool-call XML no longer re-parse Markdown on every token. (#166782, #171573) Thanks @boeingchoco.
- Gateway: blocked durable context-engine turns are logged once instead of on every run. (#167595) Thanks @jalehman.
- Control UI: delayed application heartbeats no longer force a reconnect. (#171253)
- Gateway: recover state ownership after sleep and wall-clock changes, and allow `openclaw gateway restart` from verified external macOS terminals. (#170790, #170354) Thanks @AnvinaLI, @sgh6688, @waynegault, and @RomneyDa.
- Gateway: bound transcript-worker shutdown waits and wait for session lifecycle publication during shutdown. (#170493, #170555) Thanks @Oldrich333.
- Gateway: start enabled standalone plugin files with the Gateway, and keep worker heap limits enforced when the managed service sets a process-wide heap flag. (#171330, #166581) Thanks @holgergruenhagen, @valkyriweb, @xydigitLybnnnn, @goslingmanagment, @waynegault, and @obviyus.
- Agents: launched plugin turns no longer fail with writer-claim errors, and Claude CLI sessions no longer fork history across message routes. (#170077, #167241) Thanks @cmatrx0.
- Agents: manual compaction settles the active run instead of aborting it. (#166163) Thanks @holny and @alexph-dev.
- OpenAI: tool turns for reasoning models on api.openai.com Completions routes no longer fail with a 400. (#166182) Thanks @obviyus and @AsTutoAI.
- Updates: agent databases are no longer flagged as changed during snapshot capture, the success summary stops repeating settled plugin data/settings upgrades as pending, and metadata inventory keeps running under progress-output backpressure. (#170351, #170413, #168493) Thanks @DonnieFi, @RomneyDa, and @vincentkoc.
- Updates: slow host admission no longer holds the database writer and disrupts Gateway work, progress keeps reporting through temporary Doctor maintenance, snapshot failures get an accurate headline and recovery advice, and Linux updates can clean up abandoned runtime directories under protected systemd user managers. (#171493, #171454, #171457, #171488, #170783, #166335) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, and @vincentkoc.
- Updates: candidate validation no longer amplifies private SQLite snapshots on live installs, older drivers stop reading candidate-migrated state and stale restart verdicts clear, and optional cron inspection or snapshot cleanup failures no longer stall updates. (#167451, #170130, #170754) Thanks @angeliti999 and @RomneyDa.
- Updates: `openclaw update repair` turns no longer time out before running tools on slower hosts; nested authority checks reuse the current state snapshot instead of copying the database again. (#166847)
- Doctor: updates no longer refuse unreferenced retired OAuth sidecars, and offline state repair works for app-owned Gateways. (#165420, #170768) Thanks @obviyus and @RomneyDa.
- Tailscale: an interrupted start stops its serve process, local access stays available when the tailnet denies Serve, and Doctor checks configured Tailscale startup prerequisites. (#167514, #171509, #166947) Thanks @pandysp and @RomneyDa.
- macOS: app recovery keeps compatible newer Gateways instead of downgrading them, and repair accepts a verified LaunchAgent bootstrap that is already in progress. (#170766, #170740) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Sessions: equivalent POSIX path aliases such as `/tmp` and `/private/tmp` no longer restart channels. (#166462) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star.
- MCP: OAuth login completes when the authorization server registers loopback redirect URIs without a port. (#170876) Thanks @9fw2pq8sgb-art.
- Browser: headless pages accept clicks while a site waits for a passkey. (#170857) Thanks @trukhinyuri.
- Control UI: updated chats recover through the serving document. (#168941)
- Tlon: never treat group DM authors as the owner. (#165801) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- Telegram: polling workers resolve in both source and package builds. (#154286) Thanks @xydt-juyaohui and @markfietje.
- Discord: agent consults keep working after voice changes. (#171029) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star and @brainmonger.
- Feishu: config hot-reload no longer orphans conversation bindings. (#169226) Thanks @ruel225, @junniar, and @obviyus.
- IRC: long non-ASCII replies are no longer lost when the server relays them. (#159730) Thanks @rodricksz4h5.
- Release: plugin npm publish tolerates repeated artifact pagination entries, Linux builds trigger after automatic requests with hosted-runner credentials, and ratchet checks read large Git baselines. (#171044, #167087, #167237, #164743) Thanks @RomneyDa and @shakkernerd.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.3..d58dd3ceef67f10eab31d93387d2c90866b3ec93 history: 61 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 61 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

releases.body:
This is a gateway-only `extended-stable` release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of September 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is [2026.10.3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases#release-v2026.10.3)

## 2026.9.33

### Highlights

- **Safer September upgrades:** updates on the 2026.9 line keep state, plugin data, service ownership, and Windows state paths intact, and refuse automatic restore over unattributed Doctor writes. (#160167, #166755) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vyctorbrzezowski, @jalehman, @Alix-007, @jayzhou2309, @nitinjwadhawan, @SunnyShu0925, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, @taihartman, and @DonnieFi.
- **Updates that finish on pnpm, npm, and Windows:** pnpm 12 Gateway services and launchers survive native updates, retained updater runtimes no longer block npm recovery, and Windows updates no longer roll back after Doctor rechecks driver ancestry. (#170003, #170131, #170170, #169563) Thanks @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **New model support:** run Meta Muse Wonder, use MiniMax M3.1 thinking effort levels, and stay signed in to MiniMax portal OAuth past token expiry. (#170232, #160089, #160459) Thanks @RomneyDa, @NianJiuZst, @Takhoffman, @php737, @masatohoshino, @rongtianhua, @DonnieFi, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **More reliable model turns:** agent runs honor live thinking levels, local providers get response-header deadlines, ChatGPT WebSocket normal closes recover, and Codex replies keep their final tokens. (#168566, #168282, #167512, #168400) Thanks @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @mightyx, @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, and @ajmtrz.
- **Work survives Gateway restarts:** interrupted automation turns, steered sessions, cloud worker claims, and partial worker replies now resume or persist after a restart. (#170162, #170252, #170161, #170223) Thanks @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.

- **Agent and update stability:** carry a broad batch of compatible October fixes for agent turns, sessions, channels, and update recovery. (#170476) Thanks @RomneyDa, @yetval, @Dimitri-lcht, @Program-123, @dhruv1220, @Shenrui-Ma, @igs-rogenlo, @changeroa, @hxy91819, @Takhoffman, @harjothkhara, @TYY-2005, @giodl73-repo, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @jalehman, @wangmiao0668000666, and @an2in.

### Changes

- **Meta:** add the Muse Wonder model to the catalog and onboarding with max thinking support, keeping Spark as the default. (#170232) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **MiniMax:** add the MiniMax M3.1 Flash Preview model and route its thinking effort levels to the provider. (#160089) Thanks @NianJiuZst, @Takhoffman, @php737, @DonnieFi, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **LM Studio:** refreshing saved inventory now discovers newly loaded models. (#168039) Thanks @jb-lopez, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.

### Fixes

- **Update and Doctor:** keep Doctor running under unreadable supervisors and child binding errors, keep clean service install refusals out of native-authority recovery, stop update history writes from stalling cron and cleanup, avoid bookkeeping-only repair refusals, and never delete an OAuth profile because the legacy auth store is unreadable. - **Channels and tools:** channel tools keep working after a config write restarts the account, ACP agents keep plugin and OpenClaw tools when acpx is installed separately, Talk consultations no longer abort right after connecting, and routed turns deliver blocking questions. (#169102, #168291) Thanks @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **Release checks:** Windows installer checks tolerate slow `gateway stop` help and surface cleanup errors, packaged checks recover from a busy Gateway port, and extended-stable candidates now qualify upgrades from the previous extended-stable release. (#169567, #170178, #171565) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.

releases.name: openclaw 2026.10.5-beta.3
releases.body:
## 2026.10.5-beta.3

### Highlights

- **Updates leave the Gateway running:** pnpm 12 installs keep their Gateway service and `openclaw` launcher on the durable install path, Windows updates accept qualified Scheduled Task accounts and their own verified driver, macOS accepts protected Bun service commands, and clean service-install refusals no longer leave the Gateway stopped. (#170003, #169059, #170131, #169244, #169481, #169563, #170006, #169662, #169658, #169915) Thanks @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @RomneyDa, @jokerman1302-eng, and @vincentkoc.
- **Stuck updates recover:** updates settle package-activation journals after filesystem remounts or device-number drift, ride out a briefly locked state database, stop reporting false post-install failures after migration, and reclaim retained updater runtimes that blocked npm recovery. (#169410, #170046, #169050, #169352, #168210, #170130, #169422, #170170, #169463) Thanks @patrickschiller, @RomneyDa, @SergeiAug, @angeliti999, and @Warhangel.
- **Doctor keeps credentials and data:** Doctor no longer deletes an OAuth profile when the legacy auth store is unreadable, refuses retired state before migrating the database, imports retained ACP metadata, and restores a stopped Gateway when cleanup fails. (#170256, #168959, #170051, #169918, #169759, #169783) Thanks @Yolo521-bot, @bautrey, and @RomneyDa.
- **Turns survive restarts:** interrupted turns, subagent work, automation turns, steered sessions, and node-hosted turns resume after a Gateway restart, and streamed replies from a killed worker stay in history. (#168650, #169144, #170162, #170252, #170161, #170223)
- **Telegram never replays old updates:** the first start after updating no longer re-dispatches months-old Telegram updates from the legacy spool as new owner instructions. (#170068, #169784) Thanks @angeliti999.
- **Codex and provider replies complete:** Codex replies keep their last tokens and accept follow-ups after a failed thread preparation, ChatGPT turns retry a mid-stream WebSocket close, and DeepSeek tool markup no longer leaks into messages. (#168400, #169431, #167512, #167345, #169728, #159665) Thanks @RomneyDa, @jjjhenriksen, @ericcurtin, @obviyus, @mightyx, and @TOMUIV.
- **Meta Muse Wonder:** Meta users can select `meta/muse-wonder-1.0` with tools, image input, streaming, reasoning controls, and a 1M-token context window. (#170232) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Plugin SDK compatibility:** plugins built against 2026.10.1 and 2026.10.2 can import `createSessionHeaderLink` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/control-ui` again. (#169746) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Changes

- **Meta Muse Wonder:** adds `meta/muse-wonder-1.0` with text and image input, tools, streaming, encrypted reasoning replay, and a 1,048,576-token context window; Spark remains the onboarding default. (#170232) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Device joins:** the CLI and Control UI join command now installs a background node service that can host agent sessions (`--service --session-host`), with a command-only service alternative, and already-paired devices get a working command to enable session hosting. (#168623) Thanks @obviyus.

### Fixes

- **Telegram:** legacy spool updates older than 24 hours are imported as stale and never dispatched, so already-handled messages are not executed again after an update. (#170068, #169784) Thanks @angeliti999.
- **Plugin SDK compatibility:** `createSessionHeaderLink` is restored in `openclaw/plugin-sdk/control-ui` as a deprecated export for plugins built against 2026.10.1 and 2026.10.2. (#169746) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Reply delivery:** streamed text from a killed native worker stays in history with its real failure, steered messages behind subagent announcements are no longer dropped as interrupted, blocking questions from routed agent turns reach their conversation, live sends survive delivery recovery, WebChat no longer shows false attachment errors or duplicate file cards, Talk consultations no longer abort right after connecting, and deleting a session records its cancellation before draining retained replies. (#170223, #168077, #170039, #169010, #169093, #170083) Thanks @RomneyDa and @brokemac79.
- **Restart recovery:** turns interrupted while a session was still preparing resume after a restart, interrupted subagents return to their parent with their history, automation turns, steered sessions, and node-hosted turns resume instead of failing with an active turn claim, a Gateway restarts cleanly when a stored cloud worker's machine is gone, and symlinked state directories keep working after a restart. (#168650, #169144, #170162, #170252, #170161, #168907, #168361) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Nodes and channels:** node requests and events no longer fail with "pairing changed" during another device's pairing activity, and channel tools keep working after a config write restarts the account. (#169486, #169575, #159396) Thanks @ceckert and @RomneyDa.
- **macOS app:** fresh app installs authenticate to their app-hosted Gateway and finish setup faster, and the Gateway reconnects automatically after a trusted TLS certificate renewal. (#169403, #168151)
- **Codex and OpenAI:** Codex replies keep their final tokens when a stream drops the last delta, Codex follow-ups work after a failed thread preparation, ChatGPT turns retry a mid-stream WebSocket close with code 1000, and personal-account quota rechecks no longer abort replies. (#168400, #169431, #167512, #167345, #170065) Thanks @RomneyDa, @jjjhenriksen, @ericcurtin, @obviyus, and @mightyx.
- **Models and providers:** DeepSeek tool-call markup is recovered instead of leaking into messages, Claude CLI sessions call registered OpenClaw tools by their MCP names, providers that never send response headers time out, agent runs honor the provider's live thinking levels without reloading catalogs, LM Studio refresh discovers new models, llama.cpp setup keeps aliased models and fails when credentials cannot be saved, and guarded model requests fall back to IPv6. (#169728, #159665, #153032, #168282, #168566, #168039, #150262, #168232, #168973, #87763) Thanks @TOMUIV, @kiranvk-2011, @RomneyDa, @obviyus, @jb-lopez, @an2in, and @georgenaz.
- **MiniMax:** M3.1 models honor their thinking effort levels, and MiniMax OAuth sign-ins refresh expired tokens instead of failing about two hours after login. (#160089, #160037, #160459, #77467) Thanks @NianJiuZst, @Takhoffman, @php737, @masatohoshino, and @rongtianhua.
- **ACP and compaction:** ACP agents keep plugin and OpenClaw tools when acpx is installed as a separate package, and the next turn after native compaction no longer fails while the transcript projection rebuilds. (#164272, #164211, #169583) Thanks @jayzhou2309, @obviyus, and @ajmtrz.
- **Automations:** manual runs keep tool access after the starting turn ends, cron no longer holds the state writer while waiting on the host so updates do not fail with a locked database, and a one-shot automation that fails terminally now sends a failure notice instead of disabling silently. (#168037, #168291) Thanks @obviyus.
- **pnpm and platform updates:** pnpm 12 Gateway services and `openclaw` launchers stay on the durable install link after updates, Windows updates accept qualified Scheduled Task account names and no longer roll back when Doctor re-checks ancestry, macOS updates accept protected Bun service commands, and clean service-install refusals stay recoverable. (#170003, #169059, #170131, #169244, #169481, #169563, #170006, #169662, #169658) Thanks @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @RomneyDa, and @jokerman1302-eng.
- **Update recovery:** package-activation journals settle after filesystem remounts and device-number drift, retained updater runtimes outside `node_modules` are reclaimed and never hard-link recovery files, upgrades keep state ownership across the heartbeat transition, and update-time Doctor keeps its child identities after a failed custody binding. (#169410, #170046, #169050, #169352, #170170, #169463, #169915, #169665) Thanks @patrickschiller, @RomneyDa, @SergeiAug, @Warhangel, and @vincentkoc.
- **Update outcomes:** updates with a running Gateway no longer record false post-install failures after migration, unsafe Doctor recovery guidance is kept until settled, candidate bookkeeping no longer makes older updaters refuse their config repair, and Doctor cleanup during updates no longer fails with nested-effect errors. (#170130, #169422, #170207, #170195, #170070, #168750) Thanks @angeliti999, @hannesrudolph, and @ezimerman.
- **Update database contention:** updates ride out a briefly locked state database, update history writes no longer stall Gateway cron and cleanup, and Doctor recovery captures stay stable while shared-state workers remain open. (#168210, #169283, #170022) Thanks @DonnieFi.
- **Doctor data safety:** Doctor keeps OAuth profiles when the legacy auth store is unreadable, refuses retired state before migrating the database, imports retained ACP metadata after archiving legacy session stores, restores a stopped Gateway when cleanup fails, and removes the `(multiple)` store sentinel registered as an agent database. (#170256, #168959, #170051, #169918, #169759, #169783, #170043, #169764) Thanks @Yolo521-bot, @bautrey, @RomneyDa, and @ourcoms2018.
- **oc-path:** `openclaw path set` refuses malformed UTF-8 before writing, preserving the file's bytes. (#168491) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666 and @Takhoffman.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.5-beta.2..463017d7dfa5fcbcb6fff97f32c17e09267c2b5a history: 71 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 71 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.
